verdict.rationale: Phoenix exposes a first-party remote MCP endpoint (`/mcp`). Any MCP-compatible client (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code) can then search, query, and operate on projects, traces, datasets, experiments, prompts, and annotations through natural-language instructions. Its docs also describe letting a coding agent set up tracing via the phoenix-cli. However, natural-language operation depends on an external agent client, and the evidence shows no built-in in-product natural-language assistant. Missing for 10: a native in-app natural-language command interface, hands-on or independent corroboration of MCP-driven operation, and detail on which operations are supported beyond the summary claim.
